== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added from [https://web.archive.org/web/20040617171106/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/dpcchicagoupdate04092003.htm DPC Chicago Begins on Friday!] (9 April 2003) and the already-cited DPC Chicago announcement (pc-dpcchi): the added prizes (cash prize for the highest-placing player rated under 1700; virtual card design for the runner-up), the players confirmed in advance and their home states, the Fred/Hays Spades or Hearts challenge, the Team Tournament prize (uncut sheets) and the weekend's Lord of the Rings TCG and Magi-Nation Duel events.
=== Missing data ===
* The winner of the under-1700 cash prize and whether [[Brian Fred]] designed a virtual card as runner-up are not in these sources.
* The Team Tournament and Lord of the Rings / Magi-Nation results are not in these sources.

== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
* Sources (Players Committee forum): [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625212948/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23884%26amp DPC Chicago Coverage begins NOW!] (post 23801, 10 April 2003); [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625212948/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23884%26amp DPC Chicago Coverage begins NOW!] (post 23884, 12 April 2003); [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625210814/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23848%26amp Live Coverage UPDATE #1] (post 23848, 11 April 2003); [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625211749/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23865%26amp Live Coverage UPDATE #2] (post 23859, 12 April 2003); [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625212539/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23882%26amp Live Coverage UPDATE #3] (post 23870, 12 April 2003); [https://web.archive.org/web/20040131132845/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1299%26amp Live Coverage UPDATE #4] (post 23883, 12 April 2003); [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625214828/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23900%26amp Live Coverage UPDATE #5] (post 23893, 12 April 2003); [https://web.archive.org/web/20040625214828/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23900%26amp Live Coverage UPDATE #5] (post 23897, 12 April 2003); [https://web.archive.org/web/20040618033055/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23940%26amp Live Coverage UPDATE #6] (post 23904, 12 April 2003); [https://web.archive.org/web/20040618033055/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=23940%26amp Live Coverage UPDATE #6] (post 23924, 13 April 2003).
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The existing refs mislabel the live-coverage topics. pcf-1296 (t=1296) is cited as "Update #3" for the 25-player quote, but topic 1296 is titled "Live Coverage UPDATE #2" and has only the Friday Lord of the Rings report; the quote is in topic 1297 ("UPDATE #3"). pcf-1297 is cited as "Update #4" but topic 1297 is Update #3; the round-4 standings it supports are in topic 1299 ("UPDATE #4"). pcf-1299 is cited as "Update #5" for the five-round summary and deck list, but topic 1299 is Update #4; that text is in topic 1302 ("UPDATE #5"). New refs to the right posts were added next to the old ones; the old refs were left as they were.
* The 12 April poll (post 23884) gives Mike Gemme, Justin Desai, Clint Hays, Michael Raveling and Eric Olson one vote each; only the Chu/Hunter/Desai vote counts were used.
=== Marginal cuts ===
* Greg Zinn's reply about the runner-up v-card prize (post 23868; the prize is already on the page) and Howard's promise to post at least the top-4 decks (post 23908; the posting is already on the page).
=== Missing data ===
* Final Swiss standings beyond the top 4 (other than Sithborg's 16th) and the final's result details are not in these posts. Gustaf Olson, James Beyer and Jeff Desando have no pages.
